bmt-2025-calculus-tiebreaker-01.prompt:
Let $f(x)=\dfrac{x+1}{x^3+1}$. Find the real number $c$ such that
$$f(c)=\lim_{x\to-1}f(x).$$

bmt-2025-calculus-tiebreaker-02.prompt:
For positive real numbers $a$ and $b$, define the function
$$f(a,b)=\int_0^{a/b}\frac{1}{a+bx}\,dx.$$
Compute $\max\{f(20,25),f(25,20)\}$.
